summary: LAST SIGNAL is an educational 3D adventure and exploration video game designed for children aged 8 to 12. We have developed a prototype featuring Oppy—inspired by NASA’s Opportunity rover—which allows players to explore the surface of Mars, investigate environmental features, and learn about key moments from the rover’s mission. Through interactive scenarios and mouse-based movement and exploration controls, players discover topics such as the characteristics of the Martian soil, rocks, craters, evidence of ancient water, and the impact of dust storms. The project addresses the "Abandoned but Not Forgotten" challenge by transforming the stories of space equipment—whose missions have come to an end—into engaging, playful learning experiences. Our goal is to spark children's scientific curiosity and bring them closer to the world of space exploration. Looking ahead, we plan to incorporate other NASA robots and missions.
details:
LAST SIGNAL is a 3D educational video game in which children control "Oppy"—inspired by NASA’s Opportunity rover—to explore Mars, investigate its terrain, and uncover the history of its mission through challenges and interactive elements. The prototype was developed using HTML, with Visual Studio Code as the development environment. Its creative approach transforms real scientific data into an adventure, allowing children to learn through exploration and play.

The project aims to spark scientific curiosity. Furthermore, it provides educational institutions with a supplementary digital resource for teaching science and technology in an engaging, playful way. Key considerations included accessibility, low development costs, and ease of use on standard computers, without the need for specialized equipment. Future plans include the addition of new levels featuring other robots and space missions.
